knowledge_gaps: The proposal respects the single-model HSTU constraint and is a reasonable first experiment; a different backbone is unnecessary. However, baseline-versus-CNN alone cannot attribute gains to order sensitivity rather than added capacity or text availability. A capacity-matched unordered title encoder is the most relevant additional control.

Reproduction details remain unspecified: exact tokenizer expression, vocabulary scope and cutoff, deterministic vocabulary ordering, convolution activation and padding, pooling-bin boundaries, and assignment of windows crossing bin boundaries. Width-2/3 valid-window masking gives no text signal for one-token titles; define short-title handling and explicitly zero residuals when no valid windows exist, including after biased projections and LayerNorm.

A gate initialized to -3 does not necessarily make the intervention small: sigmoid(-3) is about 0.047, but LayerNorm fixes residual scale independently of ID-embedding norms. Measure the residual-to-ID norm ratio, specify initialization, and ensure added parameters enter the optimizer. Report title coverage, truncation and unknown-token rates, particularly for rare model numbers.

The proposed experiment does not yet distinguish semantic text use from brand, popularity or item-identity shortcuts. Retrained shuffled-title and unordered-text controls would help; report omitted controls if the budget cannot accommodate them. Titles cannot establish physical compatibility or satisfied needs.

The validation plan needs the actual checkpoint schedule, tie rule and coordination across four independently trained category models. Report paired per-user hit changes when available and acknowledge repeated validation selection. One changed user hit changes macro HR@10 by 0.125 percentage points. The supplied combined_score=0.5887 is not explicitly identified as this pinned metric.

Runtime feasibility is unmeasured. Repeatedly encoding titles for sequence, positive and negative items may dominate training; inference caching is valid only from the selected checkpoint. Preserve gradients when deduplicating title computations during training, retain the required full-catalog recommendations for twenty training users, and budget all diagnostics.

Originality 5 and future potential 7 are plausible subjective assessments, not evidence-backed findings. Difficulty 5 may understate efficient implementation and checkpoint parity. The character-CNN citation is an indirect precedent for a token CNN, and the exact identity and claims of the MARS reference need verification.
